name: Uldaman Reagent Run

faq.answer: Jarkal Mossmeld is an alchemist stationed in Kargath who wants to study newly discovered flora.
faq.q: Who is asking for the fungus caps?

aliases: where do magenta fungus caps grow
where to find fungus in uldaman
faq.answer: They grow in clusters deep inside the ancient dig site of Uldaman.
faq.q: Where are the magenta fungus caps found?

aliases: why does jarkal want magenta fungus
what are magenta caps used for
faq.answer: He wants to examine their properties and investigate how they might serve in alchemy.
faq.q: Why does Jarkal want the fungus?

faq.answer: The clusters can release poisonous spores when disturbed or jostled.

aliases: what is the reward for jarkal
faq.answer: He promises a batch of his greater mender's potion once you bring him a dozen caps.
faq.q: What does Jarkal offer in return?

sections.body: Gathering the specimens carries real danger, for disturbing the clusters can trigger a burst of venomous spores. Once gathered, Jarkal Mossmeld expects a dozen caps brought back to Kargath, where he plans to test their alchemical value and brew restorative draughts.
sections.title: Spores in the Deep

summary: In Kargath, Jarkal Mossmeld seeks freshly discovered magenta fungus caps that sprout deep within Uldaman. He hopes to unravel their alchemical uses, though harvesting them means braving hazardous spores.
attribution: In-game quest text: Uldaman Reagent Run
